title: Midlands PM2.5 exposure and its sources: code and derived data
description: Python and R code, source manifests, derived tables, verification records and figures for an assessment of modelled PM2.5 exposure across Midlands Province, Zimbabwe, 2017 to 2022, and (from version 1.1.0) a source-attributed exposure model that splits daily exposure into fire, local industrial and urban, and background components and attributes population-days above the WHO 24 hour guideline to each source. Inputs are public GHAP and ACAG PM2.5, WorldPop population, geoBoundaries boundaries, MODIS active fires, ERA5-Land and Sentinel-5P TROPOMI; large raster inputs are reacquired with the supplied code.
